items.title: 1- Opening up the DNA double helix (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 1- Opening up the DNA double helix: a main subheading of 19.3.3 Mechanism of DNA Replication, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 126-126.

blocks.text: DNA ki replication DNA molecule par aik ya zyada jaghon se shuru hoti hai jahan nucleotides ka aik khaas sequence hota hai; ise replication origin site kehte hain. Prokaryotes mein sirf aik replication origin site hoti hai, jab ke eukaryotes mein DNA ki lambai par bohat si origin sites hoti hain.

items: Initiator protein replication origin site se jur kar amal shuru karta hai.

Origin site par “kholne wale” (unwinding) enzymes, jinhein helicases kehte hain, dono strands ke nucleotide pairs (base pairs) ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds tor dete hain. Strands thore se alag ho kar do Y shakal ke structures banate hain jinhein replication forks kehte hain (dono mil kar replication bubble kehlate hain).
DNA helix ke khulne se replication fork ke aage supercoils (zyada bal) parh jate hain.
Enzyme gyrase (ya topoisomerase) replication fork ke aage jur jata hai aur dobara supercoiling nahin hone deta.
Single-strand binding proteins akele strands se jur kar unhein dobara jurne aur lipatne se rokte hain.
Dono replication forks aik doosre se door hatte hain taa ke dono forks par replication ho sake. Dono akele strands agle qadmon ke liye template (saancha) bante hain.
